programs.title: Dragon Warriors
programs.desc: Dragons, warriors, orcs, bounty hunters, goblins, wizards, elves, witches, maidens in distress, beautiful princesses, romance, true love, betrayal and magic come together when an unlikely group of heroes embark on a quest to save the land from an evil wizard who has sent a fire-breathing dragon to kill everyone in his realm who has fallen in love.

programs.title: Dark Night of the Scarecrow
programs.desc: In a small Southern town, four vigilantes wrongfully execute a mentally-challenged man, but after the court sets them free, they begin to mysteriously experience deadly "accidents."

programs.title: Undercover Hooligan
programs.desc: From the creators of Rise of the Footsoldier - a suspended cop is sent undercover to infiltrate a notorious London criminal gang but struggles to keep his cover when he is dragged deeper and deeper into a world of failed operations, people trafficking, murder and extortion.

programs.title: The Sentinel
programs.desc: A fugitive Secret Service agent must clear himself of murdering a colleague.
